title: the wood stain leeched out, bothers me
text:
the wood stain leeched out, bothers me. I decided to soak these in very hot water when they got here. Later when I checked on them, the water was brown and nasty. Now, who knows what this is from? I don't know where these are made or what they used on them. So, naturally, this bothered me. Next, I ran them through the dishwasher. They came out looking pretty bleached. I felt safer now. After oiling them up and letting them set for a few days, they look good. Now I am using them. They work very well.

I like them, now.
